command:
set -euo pipefail
for p in "$HOME/frankenstein" "$HOME/frankenstein-repo" "$HOME/.claude/star" "$HOME/frankenstein-2.0"; do
  if git -C "$p" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "CHECKOUT=$p"
    git -C "$p" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true
    printf 'HEAD='; git -C "$p" rev-parse HEAD
    printf 'BRANCH='; git -C "$p" branch --show-current
    printf 'DIRTY_COUNT='; git -C "$p" status --porcelain=v1 | wc -l
  fi
done
